_comment: Who a task belongs to is its assignee. owner = the user (empty: the `email` line of .credentials). runners = AI users: assigning one makes it run the task (ia·plan / ia·ejecutar / a pack decides what). Emails, no ids: ids are per project and resolved at run time. Keep in sync with api/src/tv-modules/start/aiUsers.ts and web/src/composables/useAiAssign.ts.
